test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a property associated with compounds?

options.text: The constituents can be separated fairly easily by physical methods.
The composition of each new substance is always fixed.
The new substance has totally different properties.
Elements react to form new compounds.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The constituents can be separated fairly easily by physical methods.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **compound** is a substance composed of two or more different **elements** that are **chemically bonded** together in a **fixed proportion** by mass.
 
• The constituents of a compound cannot be separated by **physical methods** such as **filtration**, **evaporation**, or **distillation**. They can only be separated into their constituent elements by **chemical or electrochemical reactions**. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect (and thus the correct answer).***
